scene_type: 2D (real footage; the cylinder also moves slightly toward the camera, see notes)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t * fps)
units: pixels of the original 1920x1080 frame, seconds; no metric scale anywhere

camera.type: handheld, nearly static: slow smooth drift, no pan
camera.drift_total_px: frame 0 -> frame 44: content moves about +8 px in x and -13 px in y (shift_x/shift_y = where the frame-44 image centre sits in frame i: -8.2, +13.0 at frame 0, 0 at frame 44)
camera.drift_per_frame_px: about 0.2 px in x, 0.3 px in y per frame; rotation under 0.27 deg; scale change under 0.25 percent
camera.note: drift is under 0.5 percent of the cylinder's per-frame motion (about 55-70 px per frame). tracks/cylinder.csv has raw image coordinates (cx_mask, cy_mask) and coordinates mapped into frame-44 background coordinates (cx_stab, cy_stab)

perspective.view: camera at desk height, looking horizontally across a light-wood desk; the desk front edge runs horizontally across the image at about y 980 (frame 44); the wall/monitor behind; no strong vanishing lines
perspective.depth_note: the cylinder starts level with the kettle's front and finishes in front of the bowl, a little nearer the camera: its image bottom edge goes from y about 823 (frame 4) to about 956 (frame 30), and its vertical extent grows from about 215 px to about 270 px. Part of that growth comes from turning end-on, and part from coming closer (roughly 10-20 percent larger apparent size)

cylinder.description: white cylinder (paper or foam roll with a central hole in its end face) lying on its side and rolling across the desk from right to left. It is the ONLY moving object
cylinder.distinguish: only moving object; bluish-white; the other white object, the wavy bowl at the left, is static
cylinder.visible_frames: 0-34 (0-3 partly cut off by the right image edge as it enters; 4-30 fully in view; 31-33 cut off by the left edge; 34 only a thin blurred sliver at the left edge, not measured; 35-44 gone)
cylinder.reference_point: visible centre = centroid of the silhouette mask (cx_mask_px, cy_mask_px). Leading (left) edge = bbox_x0
cylinder.orientation: frames 3-12: axis about 18-32 deg from horizontal in the image, side surface and lower-right end face both visible, silhouette about 300 x 186 px (length x width). From frame 13 on: end face points at the camera (axis roughly along the line of sight), silhouette about 230-250 px wide and 255-270 px high. The axis turns between frames 12 and 13

frames_20_28_end_on.bbox_w_mask: 216-233 (mask trailing edge 10-20 px short; by-eye width about 233 at frame 24 and 250 at frame 27)

tea_bottle_yellow_cap.position: second from left, plastic bottle of iced tea, yellow cap, nutrition label facing camera

red_kettle.position: right of centre, red T-fal electric kettle, 0.8 L, handle on its right

black_monitor.position: behind the bottles, top cut off by the frame

desk_lamp.position: far right, black arm lamp with round base

power_strip_and_cables.position: behind the bowl and tea bottle against the wall

desk.position: light wood desk top, glossy (shows reflections), front edge at y about 980

events.event: cylinder already moving left and entering from the right edge
cylinder fully inside the frame (right edge clear)
cylinder passes in front of the red kettle
axis turns so the end face points at the camera (silhouette changes from elongated to near-square)
cylinder passes in front of the green bottle and then the tea bottle
cylinder passes in front of the lower part of the white bowl
leading edge reaches the left image edge
last frame with the cylinder visible (thin sliver)

events.note: no release, bounce, impact or contact with another object is seen. The cylinder rolls continuously left and slightly down the image (toward the camera) with no reversal. Motion starts before frame 0 and ends after it leaves the frame

files.tracks/cylinder.csv: per-frame cylinder track (0-44; not_visible rows are empty)
files.static_objects.json: pixel extents of the static objects at frame 44
files.scripts/: all measurement scripts (run from the scene_ws folder)
